topics.label: Lecture Introduction and Framing
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer introduces the overarching themes of the lecture on cancer evolution, the microenvironment, and the core learning outcomes.

topics.label: Genetic Selection and Epigenetic Influence in Clonal Expansion
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how cancer clones acquire competitive growth advantages through successive genetic mutations and epigenetic alterations.

topics.label: Stem Cell Properties and Hierarchies in the Cell of Origin
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics evaluate the evidence and models regarding whether tumors originate from and are propagated by stem-like cell populations.

topics.label: Microenvironmental Promotion and Stromal Dependency in Tumorigenesis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics demonstrate that malignant outgrowth requires permissive external factors such as inflammation, environmental promoters, and supportive stromal cells.

topics.label: Emerging Technologies for Profiling Tumors and Microenvironments
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic outlines experimental methodologies, including single-cell genomics and spatial omics, used to study cancer evolution and cellular interactions.

topics.label: Synthesis of Multi-Factorial Tumor Coevolution
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic integrates how genetics, cell of origin, and microenvironmental signaling converge to drive the evolutionary progression of cancer.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer concludes the session and previews the topic for the next lecture.
